# docwright
Document generation for deepseek-harness: a pack defines one document type (JSON schema, validation
rules, generation prompt), packs chain into multi-stage scenarios, tunable params pass a confirmatio
n gate before generation, every document ships with a replayable validation receipt, and a bundled s
kill teaches the agent to author new packs.
JSON is the single source of truth. Every generated document is validated against its pack's JSON Sc
hema and rule set; failures are fed back to the model for repair until all rules pass (or the loop e
xhausts and keeps a red-marked draft). Every document ships with a machine-readable receipt anyone c
eeps a red-marked draft). Every document ships with a machine-readable receipt anyone can re-verify.

You get an all-green receipt in seconds — zero LLM calls. This is the deterministic first-run moment

## Tools
### `doc_packs`
Zero-arg discovery tool: lists installed packs as `[{ name, version, description, languages, consume
s, params }]` (params = the pack's declared tunables with type, description, optional default, and t
he `required`/`confirm`/`overridable`/`extractable` flags). The model-facing descriptions of `doc_ge
nerate`/`doc_validate` carry a static invitation to call `doc_packs` first; unknown-pack errors also
point there. Descriptions never change with the pack set (pull-based progressive disclosure).
### `doc_generate`
| Parameter | Type | Notes |

| `pack` | string | e.g. `cosmic-plan`; unknown names list available packs |
| `materials` | string[
]? | paths relative to the materials root (default `<workspace>/references/`), or inline text starti

ng with `#!inline`; optional for chained packs whose upstream carries the context |
| `language` | s

tring? | default: config `defaultLanguage`, else the pack's first language |
| `upstream` | string[]
? | workspace-relative paths to upstream artifacts; each must carry a green sidecar receipt (hash-ve
rified, pack type matched against `consumes`, and recording the installed pack version — see `upstre
amVersionPolicy`). Extra green artifacts of installed packs may ride along as prompt context (e.g. t

he project context beside a plan); at least one consumed type is required |
| `artifactName` | strin
g? | output base name (default `<pack>-<timestamp>`); refused on packs with an `artifactPrefix` (PLA
N/REQ/FUNC/TECH) — those are engine-named `<PREFIX>-<topicNo>` (whole-requirement) and `<PREFIX>-<to
picNo>-<NN>` (per-function; NN = the two-digit right-aligned targetIndex); topicNo comes from the to

pic name via the pack's `topicNoPattern` regex |
| `maxRounds` | number? | round cap for this call (

user intent via the model); clamped to config `maxRoundsCeiling` |
| `topic` | string? | topic direc
tory name (a plain `[A-Za-z0-9._-]` segment, e.g. the requirement id): relocates the output root to
`<topic>/output/` and the materials root to `<topic>/references/`; REQUIRED by the cosmic chain stag

es (plan/req/func/tech — one requirement per topic), ignored by workspace-scope packs |
| `force` |

boolean? | bypass the reuse pre-check and rebuild |
| `params` | object? | overrides for pack-declar
ed tunables (see `doc_packs`); unknown names, out-of-range values, and missing required (default-les
s) params fail loud; **passing params that change the upstream-recorded values triggers the confirma
tion gate** — re-passing upstream-identical values counts as inheritance; gate level tunable via `co

nfirmPolicy` (config or per-call: `none`/`standard`/`strict`) |
[该节后续省略]
### `doc_extract_params`
Material param extraction with machine-checkable provenance (`docs/designs/params-and-chain-contract
.md`, extract-params). For packs whose manifest marks params `extractable: true` (see `doc_packs`),
run this BEFORE `doc_generate`: for each extractable param propose `{ value, quote }` — `quote` must
be a verbatim excerpt of the materials (whitespace-insensitive; the engine verifies and refuses unp
roven values) — or `{ notFound: true }`, optionally with a `suggestion`/`rationale` for the user to
endorse (never auto-applied). "Not found" is a first-class result: a required param left notFound is
intercepted before generation and must be asked from the user — the materials must not be silently
substituted for. Results persist as `<pack>.extracted.json` next to the pack's artifacts; `doc_gener
ate` re-verifies every quote against the generation-time materials, so changed materials invalidate
unproven entries, and a re-extracted different value bypasses the reuse pre-check (the receipt's as-
run params no longer match) and reaches the confirmation gate.
### `doc_validate`
Re-runs the ruleset over an existing artifact — deterministic, no LLM. `artifactPath` is workspace-r
elative (e.g. `output/plan-123.json`). Returns a fresh receipt; a hash mismatch means the artifact c
hanged after generation.
**Sealing**: a green validation re-issues (seals) the sidecar receipt for the current content (`seal
ed: true`) — externally edited artifacts that revalidate green rejoin the chain without regeneration
. A red validation never touches the sidecar. Results also carry a best-effort artifact `summary` (c
ounts and totalCfps).

## Limitations
- Receipts are tamper-evident, not tamper-proof (no signature): accidental edits go red; a determine

d attacker can forge both artifact and receipt.
- Repair-loop observability lives in the receipt (pe
r-round issue counts and prompt hashes); the receipt rides the doc_generate tool result into the ses
sion log verbatim. A dedicated session event type is future work (dsh has no write-side knob to mark

plugin event types ignorable).
- Materials are trusted input: malicious material content can steer
generation (documented trust model; accepted at review, nonce delimiters deferred).
